verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's docs say the Relay Proxy connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API and proxies that connection to clients. Independent users report that SDK clients download all flags on connection, then stream changes over server-sent events with minimal latency, so flag changes reach connected SDKs without polling delay. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of propagation latency in seconds, documentation of a fast-polling fallback mode, and explicit kill-switch semantics or timing guarantees.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills
